questions.stem: A 58-year-old woman with metastatic breast cancer develops exertional dyspnea and is found to have a large pericardial effusion, jugular venous distension, and hypotension. Which of the following signs is likely present?
questions.stemHtml: A 58-year-old woman with metastatic breast cancer develops exertional dyspnea and is found to have a large pericardial effusion, jugular venous distension, and hypotension. Which of the following signs is likely present?

options.label: A
options.text: Collapse of the right ventricle throughout systole on echocardiography

options.label: B
options.text: Collapse of the right ventricle during diastole on echocardiography

options.label: D
options.text: Rise of blood pressure during inspiration
